summary: Reconstructed the figure as a compiled TikZ trapezoid ABCD (version 1). Vertices A, D (top) and B, C (bottom) were bound by CV label matching with NCC 0.84-0.90 and no ambiguous matches. The critic scored it 0.88 with no high or medium issues and must_repair=false. Its only note was that the edge strokes are heavier than the original, a low-severity style point that I did not repair.
